name: GFM
recent: GFM Services Berhad 近期获得 Pengerang Integrated Complex 的额外 RM37m 合约，使 PIC 检修订单总额增至 RM268.7m。公司也在公开市场进行股份回购，集团董事总经理 Encik Ruslan Bin Nordin 在 9 月和 10 月两度增持共 200 万股。
notable: 获得 Pengerang Integrated Complex 额外 RM37m 检修合约，订单总额增至 RM268.7m。
集团董事总经理 Encik Ruslan Bin Nordin 于 9 月 11 日和 10 月 12 日各增持 100 万股。
公司于 10 月多次在公开市场进行股份回购。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM94.98m，环比增长 14.9%，同比增长 81.4%；净利为 RM7.354m，环比增长 21.0%，同比增长 27.9%；净利率为 7.7%，高于上一季度的 7.4%。

recent_en: GFM Services Berhad recently secured an additional RM37m contract for turnaround works at Pengerang Integrated Complex, bringing total PIC turnaround orders to RM268.7m. The company has also been buying back shares on the open market, while Group Managing Director Encik Ruslan Bin Nordin acquired a total of 2 million shares in September and October.
notable_en: Secured an additional RM37m turnaround contract at Pengerang Integrated Complex, raising total orders to RM268.7m.
Group Managing Director Encik Ruslan Bin Nordin acquired 1 million shares each on 11 September and 12 October.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM94.98m, up 14.9% QoQ and 81.4% YoY; net income was RM7.354m, up 21.0% QoQ and 27.9% YoY; net margin was 7.7%, higher than 7.4% in the previous quarter.
